source_text: El paciente debe tomar el medicamento dos veces al día.
machine_translation: The patient should take the medicine twice a day.
reference_translation: The patient should take the medication twice daily.

source_text: No administre este producto a niños menores de doce años.
machine_translation: Administer this product to children under twelve years old.
reference_translation: Do not administer this product to children under twelve years of age.

errors.description: The source prohibition is omitted, reversing the instruction.

source_text: Veuillez conserver le reçu pour toute demande de remboursement.
machine_translation: Please keep the receipt for any refund request.
reference_translation: Please retain the receipt for any reimbursement request.

errors.description: The translation reverses the confidentiality requirement.

source_text: Bitte reichen Sie den Antrag bis Freitag ein.
machine_translation: Please submit the application by Friday.
reference_translation: Please submit the application by Friday.

source_text: Die Zahlung ist innerhalb von dreißig Tagen fällig.
machine_translation: Payment is due within thirty months.
reference_translation: Payment is due within thirty days.

errors.description: The translation changes the payment deadline from days to months.

source_text: El plazo de entrega es de cinco días hábiles.
machine_translation: The delivery period is five business days.
reference_translation: The delivery period is five business days.

source_text: Cliquez sur le bouton pour enregistrer les modifications.
machine_translation: Click on the button to save the changes.
reference_translation: Click the button to save the changes.

errors.description: The wording is less concise than the preferred interface instruction.

source_text: Verwenden Sie ausschließlich das zugelassene Ersatzteil.
machine_translation: Use only the approved replacement part.
reference_translation: Use only the approved replacement part.

source_text: La factura debe incluir el número de identificación fiscal.
machine_translation: The invoice must include the tax identification number.
reference_translation: The invoice must include the tax identification number.

source_text: Le logiciel prend en charge la sauvegarde automatique.

errors.description: The intended technical feature is automatic backup, not saving.

source_text: Der Vertrag verlängert sich nicht automatisch.
reference_translation: The contract does not renew automatically.
